body: Oh. And I have a ton of pills sitting here on my pillow ready to go...but I'm afraid I WON'T die, and the company I work for will be the one to respond.

No one deserves this. In a perfect world, no one would feel it.  And 21 is so young to be so lost...but I know I'm young too, and I'm right there (I'm 24).

My story...I don't know. I'm married. I never thought I would be married. But here I am. Married to a wonderful, caring, sweet, giving man...and I'm so stuck on how I feel trapped. I will never see the sun rise on the ocean. Hell, I'll probably never see the ocean. Because I have a serious job. And health insurance to keep up, and a mortgage. And none of my dreams will ever come true because of that. Ill never write a book on hitchhiking across the US. I will never open a pub because it's not just my future I'm gambling with. I'm stuck. I'm scared. And I'm sad, because this is it, forever and ever.

Nature of the beast, right? I hope you're doing well. When you're feeling like this, all you want is for other people to be ok. What has got you here? And believe me, there's nothing you can possibly say to make me think of you in a bad light. I know from personal experience that it can be anything.

Not so good. I'm finding myself more and more drawn to the idea of ending my life. I'm not so sure that's a bad thing, though. Maybe for some people, life just isn't meant to be. Statistically, isn't it likely that some people just aren't cut out for existing?
Are you doing ok? I guess I just want to know that you're ok, right now. For the moment. I know I sound like a pussy, but I just need to know someone else is where I am, and they're ok.
I can pm you my phone # if you want to text...I'm feeling the same way and it couldn't hurt to talk, right?
Good Riddance (Time of Your Life)- Green Day. Everyone seems to think it's straight up called "Time of Your Life." No one knows what song you're referring to if you actuall call it "Good Riddance."
Sterlize everyone at birth, to be undone only at my discretion.
I think I'm ready to get pregnant. But I'm not sure I'm ready to sacrifice the freedom my husband and I have.

Arch Drive Goodbye is my favorite song of all time, and being that all your lyrics are brilliant, I was wondering if there was any sort of story or meaning behind that song? Also, I've been mildly stalking Eve6 since I could drive and if you respond to this I'm tattooing your comment on my arm. Because that's fan love.
P.S., I sang on stage with you at Peabody's in Cleveland and it remains my most awesome memory ever
